services.name: Fishing Gear
services.desc: The Salty Lewer, helmed by Capt. Bryan Lewer, is a 25' Sportsman Platinum that comfortably accommodates up to 6 passengers for private inshore fishing charters. Our inshore charter fishing trips are primarily for striped bass. Inshore trips depart Perkins Cove so you can be fishing along the rocky coastline, rugged cliffs, beaches, and river mouth after a short boat ride. We offer fishing charters with durations of two, three, and four-hour and family-friendly fishing trips designed for youth as young as four years old. Custom scenic coastal cruises for guests who want to explore the dramatic beauty of the Ogunquit and southern Maine coast are also offered for private groups of up to six

services.name: Scenic Cruises
services.desc: The Ogunquit coastline boasts breathtaking views and a thriving eco system with abundant wildlife including shore birds, seals, whales, and porpoises. And under the sea those 8-legged crustaceans, Maine Lobsters! Salty Lewer Charter's Ogunquit lobster trips and scenic tours combine a Maine lobster tour and coastal scenery tour to give you and your gang a memorable "real Maine" experience creating memories to cherish long after we return to the dock. And, for just the scenery lovers, we offer 2-hour cruises along the Ogunquit coast, to Nubble Lighthouse, out to Boon Island, and beyond.
